test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If B can do 20 percent of a work in 7 days, then B can complete the entire work in how many days?
solution:
**Given:**

B can do 20 percent of a work in 7 days.

**Formula Used:**

Time to complete entire work = Time to complete part work / Part work done

**Calculation:**

Part work done by B = 20% = 20/100 = 1/5

Time to complete 1/5 of the work = 7 days

Time to complete entire work = 7 days / (1/5)

⇒ Time to complete entire work = 7 days × 5

⇒ Time to complete entire work = 35 days

**The correct answer is option 3.**
